name: pqw-skills
description: A development flow for large changes: define with the human, hand off one run at a time, let the agent deliver in slices, then verify. 25 skills plus six thinking models.

interface.longDescription: A single-session development flow for large changes. You lead the definition stage: requirement and invariants, domain impact, technology choices, formal guard, detailed design, formal docs. A handoff stage sets the spec, sizes one run and hands it off. The agent then delivers in slices with a sentinel that looks back on a fixed beat, closes each slice with structural readings and diff mutation, and hands the run back for you to verify. Six thinking-model skills and a candid-friend skill stay loaded across the flow. The skill text is written in Chinese; the README has an English guide.
defaultPrompt: Use pqw-skills to start a run for this change: begin with the requirement and invariants.
Use pqw-skills to teach me how this flow works and what I do at each step.
